res.userText: give me a concise checklist for deploying a Next.js app to Vercel
res.assistantMessage: 1. **Push to Git** — Make sure your repo is up on GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket. Vercel imports from a git provider. 2. **Import into Vercel** — Go to [vercel.com](https://vercel.com), click *Add New > Project*, and select your repository. The framework preset should auto-detect Next.js — verify it. 3. **Configure Environment Variables** — Add any `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` or server-side secrets under *Environment Variables* in the Vercel dashboard before deploying. Triple-check production values. 4. **Build & Output Settings** — Defaults usually work (`next build` produces `.next`). If you use a custom output directory or base path, set that here. Skip the override unless you know you need it. 5. **Deploy** — Hit deploy. Watch the build logs. Common gotcha: a missing dependency or `.env.local` being committed (don’t). 6. **Domain & HTTPS** — After first deploy, Vercel gives you a `*.vercel.app` URL. Add your custom domain under *Domains* and update DNS. Vercel provisions SSL automatically. 7. **Verify** — Check that environment variables load, routes work, and any API endpoints respond. Do a quick Lighthouse run if performance matters. That's it. The whole flow takes about 5 minutes if nothing breaks.
